This page presents selected research projects in which
I am or have been involved, including
competitive research grants, international
collaborations and methodological activities.

For each project, the information includes
the funding programme, research objectives,
my scientific contribution and links to
related research areas.

The projects are presented as individual
entries to provide further information on
research activities, methods and results.
